title: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry dish combining the classic Malaysian flavors of chicken satay with warm, comforting noodles.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger.
Heat coconut oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
Add the peanuts to the wok and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the noodles to the wok and stir to combine with the peanut mixture.
Return the chicken to the wok and pour in the lime juice mixture.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
